text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. However, it seems there are 
still areas where I fall short.
choice_data_list:
We didn't quite manage to meet everyone's 
goals, after all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. From now on, as a Saint, I shall 
look beyond myself and dedicate myself to 
becoming a presence that guides others."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because your goal is ambitious, 
don't forget to build a solid foundation 
beneath your feet.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Don't neglect the basics. Don't lose sight 
of the fundamentals, okay?

It's a good result, but perhaps I could 
have helped them grow a little more. Let's 
aim for everyone to be in peak condition 
next season.
